# AgentHive Inc

> AgentHive Inc (AGENTHIVEINCCOM LLC, Palm Coast, Florida) is an AI consultant who builds. First Deploy AI is the cash product ($1,500 setup — live this week or you do not pay — then $250/month) at https://firstdeploy.ai. IndexMe.lol is the honest IndexNow indexing desk at https://indexme.lol. Consulting is how you buy time in the room.

AgentHive Inc embeds working AI in real operations, then leaves it running. Public site: https://agenthiveinc.com. Distinct from other “AgentHive” names in insurance, OSS, or QpiAI.
